using namespace std;
#define ll long long
ll lsc[62], rsc[62], rsc2[62];
char s[62];
map<pair<ll,int>,ll> nm, mm;

ll comb(int n, int k) {
    if (n < k || k < 0) return 0;
    ll res = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        res = res * (n - i) / (i + 1);
    }
    return res;
}

    int r, c, n, i, cntA=0, cntB=0, ok, aSt, bSt;
    ll totalSum=0, halfSum=0, bSum, result=0;
    scanf("%d%d\n", &r, &c);
    n = 2 * (r + c);
    scanf("%s", s);
    lsc[2*r - 1] = 1;
    for (i = 2*r; i < n; i++)
        lsc[i] = lsc[i-1] * i / (i - 2*r + 1);
    for (i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        rsc[i] = comb(i, r);
        rsc2[i] = comb(i, r - 1);
    }
    halfSum = rsc[n/2] * rsc[n/2];
    for (i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (totalSum > 0) ok = 1; else ok = 0;
        if (cntB == n/2) ok = 1;
        if (cntA == n/2) ok = 0;
        if (ok) {
            cntA++;
            totalSum -= rsc2[n/2 - cntA] * rsc[n/2 - cntB];
        } else {
            cntB++;
            totalSum += rsc2[n/2 - cntB] * rsc[n/2 - cntA];
        }
    }
    totalSum = max(totalSum, -totalSum);
    mm[{0,0}] = 1;
    for (i = n - 1; i >= 2*r - 1; i--) {
        nm.clear();
        for (auto &it : mm) {
            ll sum = it.first.first;
            ll count = it.second;
            int cnt = it.first.second;
            aSt = n/2 - cnt;
            bSt = i + 1 - aSt;
            ll aSum = sum + rsc2[aSt - 1] * rsc[bSt];
            ll bSumVal = sum - rsc2[bSt - 1] * rsc[aSt];
            if (s[i] == 'A') {
                nm[{aSum, cnt + 1}] += count;
                nm[{bSumVal, cnt}] += 0;
            } else if (s[i] == 'B') {
                nm[{aSum, cnt + 1}] += 0;
                nm[{bSumVal, cnt}] += count;
            } else {
                nm[{aSum, cnt + 1}] += count;
                nm[{bSumVal, cnt}] += count;
            }
        }
        totalSum -= lsc[i];
        mm.clear();
        for (auto &it : nm) {
            ll sum = it.first.first;
            ll ncnt = it.second;
            int cnt = it.first.second;
            aSt = n/2 - cnt;
            bSt = i - aSt;
            if (cnt > n/2 || n - i - cnt > n/2) continue;
            if (sum < -halfSum - rsc[aSt] * rsc[bSt] || sum > halfSum + rsc[aSt] * rsc[bSt]) continue;

        }
